steps.caption: Client accounts
steps.narration: Here's how the manager handles clients that run Local Services Ads.

steps.caption: LSA account
steps.narration: LSA account means Local Services campaigns were found under this client.

steps.caption: LSA identified
steps.narration: Choose LSA identified to see only those clients.

steps.caption: Campaigns
steps.narration: Campaigns lists this client's campaigns, including the Local Services one.

steps.caption: Local Services campaign
steps.narration: Here it is: Local Services, Roofing.

steps.caption: Health audit
steps.narration: The health audit has Local Services checks too.

steps.caption: Charged leads to review
steps.narration: Three charged leads still need feedback. Unrated doesn't mean invalid, or eligible for credit.

steps.caption: Linked to LSA Leads
steps.narration: The fix is a link to LSA Leads, where each lead is reviewed with its dispute evidence.

steps.caption: LSA Leads
steps.narration: Choose it, and LSA Leads opens.

steps.caption: LSA accounts
steps.narration: Each account here shows how many leads it has, and how many were charged.

steps.caption: Menu: LSA Leads
steps.narration: In the Google Ads tool, LSA Leads sits right under Agency on the left.

youtube.title: How to check clients' Local Services Ads | ConstructHUB Agency Ads
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the Local Services checks in the ConstructHUB Agency Ads & LSA manager. You will filter the client list to LSA accounts, open a client's campaigns, find the charged leads that still need feedback in the health audit, and follow the link to LSA Leads.
